data.name: Aretas
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Aramaic word ‘arayt’, meaning ‘noble’, ‘virtuous’, or ‘exalted’. In the Bible, Aretas is mentioned as the name of the Arab king of Damascus, who married Herodias, the wife of his brother-in-law Herod Antipas. This marriage led to John the Baptist's execution, which ultimately brought about the downfall of Aretas' reign.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes nobility and virtue in one's actions and character.
